name: iclr2026
description: ICLR 2026 open-weight review panel for the SEAM paper. Uses the real ICLR 2026 form (even-only 0-10 overall rating; soundness/presentation/contribution 1-4; confidence 1-5) via prompts/iclr-form.md (rubric'd) and prompts/iclr-naive.md (reviewer who pasted the PDF into a chatbot). Cheap current open models. target = free-tier-chatbot threat model; tough = the reasoning canary that must not drop while targets rise; holdout (kimi) is never consulted during revision — run it only at baseline and final. Ground truth for calibration: SEP (ICLR 2025, this paper's sibling) landed at 6.67 avg with soundness 2-3, contribution 2-3, presentation 3-4. Qwen3-235B was removed as overgenerous on 2026-08-18. GPT-OSS-120B and GPT-5.6 Luna were too harsh on accepted SEP. Nemotron 3 Super reproduced SEP's 6.67 mean and 6/8 score pattern and is adopted only with the calibrated ICLR-form prompt.
